manifest.name: @twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin
manifest.description: Run one project across your own Windows and macOS machines from a single DeepSeek account, through 11 w2m_* tools. Four coordination modes (replicate, split, broadcast, pipeline) and six aggregate verdicts (consistent, divergent, divergent-platform, failed, partial, unverifiable). P2P hole punching by default, with a bundled relay, STUN responder and ledger fallback, so the fleet needs no third-party service. Joining needs a pairing code plus autoStartAgent: true; installing alone does not join.

permissions.network: the configured relay (default: the shared server above), STUN servers, and UDP to the peer machines. The optional chatops channels reach one instant-messaging platform each, and only when that channel is named in `channels` and the host has supplied the transport: the WeChat channel reaches ilinkai.weixin.qq.com and sends the bot token as a bearer credential, and both that host and the base url in a login response are checked against an allow-list before a token is sent anywhere
permissions.filesystem: read/write inside the project directory and DSH_HOME; the agent writes its spool and state under --state; the chatops file fence reads inside `projectRoot` only, after resolving symlinks

meta.title: W2M：AI 智能体舰队！
meta.description:
W2M是一个开源（MIT）的 AI 智能体舰队编排工具——用同一个 DeepSeek 、豆包、WorkBuddy账号把"你自己的多台机器"（Windows/Mac）编成一个舰队，统一派发命令、协作&协同开发。
组件有三块：Relay（HTTP+SSE 协调服务器）、Agent（每台机器上跑、执行白名单命令）、Plugin（给 Agent 用的 18 个工具）。

bundle.text:
# This file is the bundle patch declared by package.json's `dsh.bundle.patch`.
# It mounts the plugin by its package name, whose root export is the plugin
# (`lib/index.js` re-exports `./tools.js`), so reading this file tells you which
# package becomes the plugin.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Why the row names the package and not the `/tools` subpath (v0.5.4)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Until v0.5.4 this row said `name: '@twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin/tools'`, and for a
# host-only plugin that was fine. It stops being fine the moment the package also
# ships a browser half, because the client module system identifies a package by
# the *package specifier* its Loader row carries:
#
#   client-modules: resolveMeta(loaderName, baseUrl)   (dsh-client-modules)
#     exactPackageSpecifier('@twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin/tools') -> undefined
#     ... -> locatePkgJson returns undefined -> the entry is not a client package
#
# A subpath specifier resolves to no package manifest at all, so a `/tools` row is
# invisible to the scan: `lib/client.js` is never composed into `__DSH_BOOT__`, and
# the composer control can never register -- whatever else is fixed. Measured on the
# 0.5.4 tarball through the real Loader: the composed boot graph held rows for
# `@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-registry` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-gateway` and none for
# this package. Naming the bare package fixes it, because the root export already
# re-exports exactly what `/tools` exports (`test/tools.test.mjs` asserts the two
# carry the same `inject`), so the host half is unchanged. `./tools` remains a
# supported mount point for anyone who wants it -- it is simply not the one this
# bundle uses.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Why this is an `insert:` list and not a bare `- id: w2m`
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A bare `- id: w2m` entry is a *non-insert* patch: it replaces fields on an
# entry that an earlier layer already created. No earlier layer creates `w2m`,
# so the Loader reports
#
#   dsh: [@twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin] patch: entry "w2m" not found
#
# and skips it. Measured with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 (`--dump-config-schema`, $defs.patch):
#
#   "An insert appends entries, optionally inside the group identified by id.
#    Other patches replace supplied fields; ... Unknown targets and non-insert
#    patches without a nonempty id are warned and skipped."
#
# The consequence of the old shape was silent: `dsh plugin add` succeeded, the
# profile listed the bundle, DSH started cleanly -- and **no `w2m` row was ever
# composed**, so none of the eight tools existed. `--dump-config` showed 183 rows
# and zero of them named this package.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuring the relay URL, and the direct path (v0.4.0)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The relay URL has a default as of v0.4.0: the shared W2M server, which hosts the
# relay, a STUN server and a reverse proxy on one address. Leaving `rabbitUrl` empty
# therefore means "use the shared server", not "guess" -- and `w2m_status` reports
# `rabbit_source: "shared-default"` with a note naming the address, so a machine
# talking to somebody else's host can never be a surprise.
#
# The order is `rabbitUrl` -> `W2M_RABBIT_URL` -> the shared server, and an explicit
# value always wins. Set one of the first two to run against your own relay:
#
#   - id: w2m
#     config:
#       rabbitUrl: https://w2m.example.com        # may include a sub-path
#       operatorToken: !!js process.env.W2M_OPERATOR_TOKEN
#       stateDir: !!js (process.env.DSH_HOME + '/xclient')
#
# `operatorToken` is the credential that authorises *sending* instructions. It is
# separate from the per-machine device token on purpose: a machine that can receive
# work should not automatically be able to command the others. The relay writes it to
# <state>/operator-token.txt on first start and prints it once.
#
# `p2pMode` decides how a dispatched offer travels, and it is the release's headline
# switch, so every value is validated at load and a typo is refused rather than
# defaulted:
#
#   auto    (default) punch the direct path and push the offer over it; the relay's
#           own offer on the SSE stream stays as the fallback, so a failed punch is
#           invisible to the caller except in `direct_pushes` and each machine's
#           `transport`. This is what `W2M_P2P_MODE` unset gives you.
#   direct  the same push, but a failed punch is not hidden: the executor refuses an
#           offer that did not arrive over the direct path
#           (`refusal_reason: P2P_UNAVAILABLE`), so a fleet that must use the fast
#           path fails loudly instead of quietly falling back.
#   relay   no UDP socket is bound at all and nothing is dialled -- exactly v0.3.9's
#           behaviour. Use it to take the direct path out of the picture entirely
#           while diagnosing something else.
#
#   - id: w2m
#     config:
#       p2pMode: relay                            # or W2M_P2P_MODE=relay
#
# `stunServers` is the list used to discover the address a peer can reach this machine
# on. Unset means the shared server first, then three public fallbacks -- the shared
# server is asked first on purpose, because a machine that can reach the relay can
# reach that STUN server, so the address it reports is measured over the same path the
# punch will use. Naming servers replaces that list, so give the shared one explicitly
# if you still want the relay's own path measured:
#
#   - id: w2m
#     config:
#       stunServers: ['202.182.123.154:3478', 'stun.example.com:3478']
#                                                # or W2M_STUN_SERVERS=a:3478,b:3478
#
# A loopback punch (both machines on one host) exercises the code path and says nothing
# about NAT traversal; `w2m_status` reports the measured NAT mapping so the difference
# is visible rather than assumed.
- insert:
    - id: w2m
      name: '@twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin'
      config:
        rabbitUrl: ''
        operatorToken: ''
        autoStartAgent: true
        machineName: ''
        allowedCommands: []
        p2pMode: auto
        stunServers: []
    # DSH-GPW (Global Permission Watchdog) ships with this package and is **off until an operator turns it on**.
    #
    # It is in this insert list rather than left out of the tree entirely, because a plugin the composed tree does
    # not mention is a plugin the plugin manager cannot list -- and then "enable it manually" has no control to
    # click. **A row with `disabled: true` is the shape that makes it installable with the package and switchable
    # from the UI**: the component shows up, its toggle is off, and flipping it needs no file edit.
    #
    # Found this way, not assumed: v1.0.5 shipped the subpath export but no row, so the watchdog was reachable only
    # by hand-editing a profile patch. **An optional component nobody can find is not optional, it is absent.**
    #
    # What it does once enabled: answers `approval/request` with at most 10 auto-approvals per rolling 60 s, at
    # least 3000 ms apart, and defers everything past that to the human prompt, where it waits.
    - id: dsh-desktop
      name: '@twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin/desktop'
      disabled: true
      config: {}
    - id: dsh-gpw
      name: '@twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin/gpw'
      disabled: true
      config:
        maxPerWindow: 10
        windowMs: 60000
        minGapMs: 3000
        # v1.7.5+: only act in the 完全权限 preset; the two folder lists are the gate's policy.
        # Folders are added at runtime from the GPW panel into $DSH_HOME/xclient/gpw-folders.json.
        requireFullAccess: true
        whitelist: []
        blacklist: []
        pendingTimeoutMs: 120000

readme.section: W2M是一个开源（MIT）的 AI 智能体舰队编排工具
readme.text: ————用同一个 DeepSeek 、豆包、WorkBuddy账号把"你自己的多台机器"（Windows/Mac）编成一个舰队，统一派发命令、协作&协同开发。

1.Relay（HTTP+SSE 协调服务器）

2.Agent（每台机器上跑、执行白名单命令）

3.Plugin（给 Agent 用的 18 个工具）

readme.section: 功能 1 · 同一账号的 PC，登录自动编队入队
readme.text: 同一 DeepSeek 账号下的每台机器，登录即自动编队入队，无需手动配对、无需维护主机列表。从 v1.1.15 起 `autoStartAgent` 默认开启：新装的机器自行派生账号身份、加入该账号的编队，直接出现在 `w2m_devices` 中。身份以账号为键，而非手维护的 host 列表；每台机器用 Ed25519 密钥证明同一账号归属。
编队内建 `w2m_chat` 聊天通道，同一编队的机器之间可直接对话、广播消息；composer 内的聊天面板与「编队群组」标签页共享同一份消息记录。消息存储与配额已实现并测试。工具路径可使用编队密钥派生的会话加密；面板端到端加密、分片仍未构建，面板/会话镜像走 relay 时仍是明文。

readme.section: 功能 3 · 编队联合开发 & 多机跨机实时协同协作
readme.text: 不止“跑同一条命令”。`w2m_joint_plan` / `w2m_joint_status` 负责联合任务规划与状态跟踪，`w2m_run` 提供 replicate（并行对比）、split（分片执行）、pipeline（流水线）、broadcast（单机广播）四种协作模式，`w2m_council` 多机协商、`w2m_tasks` 任务面板把一组异构机器变成同一个开发编队。联合开发按《W2M Relay × ToFuture 外部对接 API v1.2》收敛：Ed25519 人签审批、`target_machines` 显式派发、409 读回、死租约拒绝；数据面投递（artifact sink）与合并 CLI 仍在接线中，relay 部署独立于插件发布。

readme.section: 功能 4 · 一键到顶：单击滚动三轮，连续点击三次到顶
readme.text: 为长会话和长日志场景设计的滚动浮标：单击一次向上滚动约三轮；1.2 秒内连续点击三次直接回到第一轮（自动展开 DSH 官方「加载更早」）。图标位于会话区右上角，与官方浮动控件同一设计规格，不依赖窗口标题栏。

readme.section: 功能 5 · 正文上下文搜索：命中文字绿字黄底高亮
readme.text: 在主工作区进行正文上下文搜索，命中的文字以黄色背景、绿色文字高亮显示，当前匹配项自动滚动进入视野；搜索覆盖正文内容与上下文，不局限于标题或元数据。

readme.section: 功能 6 · 全局文件夹读写黑白名单：保护系统盘 & 个人/工作文件夹
readme.text: DSH 默认的权限模型是“限制 or 全开”，一旦放开就难以精细控制。本插件在官方沙箱之上追加全局文件夹读写黑白名单，为系统盘（`C:\Windows`、`Program Files`、`/etc`、`/usr` 等）和个人/工作文件夹建立明确的读/写边界，避免 AI 或跨机任务误触不该动的路径。这一设计来自实际重装系统后的教训：粗粒度的“全开”代价太高，黑白名单把“绝对不允许”与“经常要放行”的路径变成可配置的硬规则。v2.0.4 起提供两种策略：**小白模式（默认）**只保留黑名单强制拒绝（内置 Windows/Program Files 等默认保护文件夹，路径操作每 3 秒最多自动放行一次），其余全部放行；**高级模式**需手动切换，保留白名单预算、待审批队列与 10 秒无人应答自动放行。

readme.section: 功能 7 · 远程桌面（仅查看，1 帧/秒）
readme.text: 在设置里打开「远程桌面」后，可在远程桌面页选择在线目标并连接。目标机也必须打开同一开关，表示同意被编队内其他机器查看；只传输画面，不发送鼠标/键盘输入。目标以 1 帧/秒采集并加密：优先 P2P 直连，P2P 不通时走 relay 的加密帧通道（relay 只看到密文，看不到 JPEG）。查看端每秒拉取最新一帧，因此最低可用帧率是 1 帧/秒；网络和采集耗时会决定实际帧率。目标关闭开关后，下一次采集立即停止。

Every install path below registers 18 tools in your agent.

五种方式，最终都会在你的 agent 里注册 18 个工具。任选其一。
```bash

readme.section: 1. 把包装进你的 DSH profile
readme.text: dsh plugin add @twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin

plugins:
  - '@twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin'

readme.section: 3. 重启 DSH。加入编队发生在 mount 时，热重载不够
readme.text:
```

从 1.1.15 起 agent 会自动启动（`autoStartAgent` 默认 true）：新装的机器自行派生账号身份、加入该账号的编队，无需配对步骤就会出现在 `w2m_devices` 里。若要关闭：

```yaml

- id: w2m
  config:
    autoStartAgent: false
```

readme.section: 2. npm（MCP 服务器，任意客户端）
readme.text:
```bash
npm install -g @twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin
w2m-mcp --help
```

把任意 MCP 客户端指向 `w2m-mcp`。零运行时依赖；包里同时带有 relay、agent 与工具。

```bash
/plugin marketplace add TwinsEarth/dsh-windows2macos
/plugin install w2m@twinsearth
```

清单文件位于 `.claude-plugin/`，版本与发行版锁定。

readme.section: 4. Codex 及其他支持 MCP 的 CLI
readme.text: ```toml

[mcp_servers.w2m]
command = "npx"
args = ["-y", "@twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin@2.2.3", "w2m-mcp"]
```

readme.section: 5. 验证过的 release tarball（离线）
readme.text:
从 v2.0.3 release 页下载 `twinsearth-w2m-dsh-plugin-2.0.3.tgz` 与 `SHA256SUMS`，然后：

```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/TwinsEarth/dsh-windows2macos/releases/download/v2.0.3/twinsearth-w2m-dsh-plugin-2.0.3.tgz
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS   # 先验证，永远先验证
npm install -g ./twinsearth-w2m-dsh-plugin-2.0.3.tgz
```

每个 release 都附带 `SHA256SUMS`，缺失的 release 不要安装。

```bash
w2m_status          # 我配对了吗？在哪个编队？
w2m_devices         # 编队里有什么机器？
w2m_run mode="replicate" command_argv=["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]
w2m_wait task_id="..."

replicate 在每台在线机器上运行，只有所有机器返回相同结果且相同 commit 锚点时，判定才是 consistent。split 给每台机器一个分片，pipeline 串联阶段，broadcast 指定一个执行者并报告观察者，compose 合并结果。

一个可安装插件，把一组机器变成一个编队，以你的账号为键，而不是手维护的主机列表。

| 组件 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| Relay | 小型 HTTP 服务器：任务路由、租约、SSE。不承载数据面对象；运行在机器可达的任何地方 |
| Agent | 每台机器上运行：配对一次、执行白名单命令、心跳 |
| Plugin | 你的 agent 调用的工具 |
| Admission (1.1.14+) | 新机器请求加入；在线成员批准，10 秒自动批准，24 小时内加入的机器可立即移除 |

`w2m_status` · `w2m_devices` · `w2m_run` · `w2m_wait` · `w2m_history` · `w2m_stats` · `w2m_report` · `w2m_memory` · `w2m_approvals` · `w2m_cancel` · `w2m_council` · `w2m_chat` · `w2m_update` · `w2m_tasks` · `w2m_reduce` · `w2m_joint_plan` · `w2m_joint_status` · `w2m_intent`

`w2m_intent` 把结构化意图（run-tests、node-version、git-status、git-head、fleet-facts、shard-probe）映射到白名单命令；未知意图按名字拒绝，绝不猜测。

命令白名单基于 argv 前缀，拒绝 argv 重解析标志（`--import`、附加 `-e`），命中时返回 `COMMAND_REPARSE_ARGUMENT`。它是边界，不是沙箱。

派发任务需要 operator token；设备 token 不能派发。
加入批准要求至少一个成员在线。
账号签名密钥从编队密钥派生，从不从账号代码派生——账号代码会写入日志，从可读值派生密钥等于交出账号身份。
每个 release 都有校验和。

一个隐藏这些事实的绿标比没有标更糟。

Verified：preflight 16 项发布门禁通过；CI 在 Windows、macOS、Linux 上通过；npm + GitHub release + 校验和一致；联合开发计划/审批/派发路径有单元测试与本地 relay 测试覆盖。

Known gaps：

| Gap | State |
|---|---|
| 真机 A–G 执行证据 | 仅完成 A/B/C/D 的路由冒烟；E/F/G 与真实执行未执行（目标机命令白名单默认拒绝、三机版本需对齐） |
| 联合开发数据面与合并 | ArtifactRef/dir-sink 与 merge-engine 已有库与单测，但 agent 投递与合并 CLI 尚未接线 |
| 进度视图 | relay 主树有 `progress` 视图；线上 relay 仍是 1.9.16，未部署该代码，插件侧消费端也在接线中 |
| 编队聊天 / 广播通道 | 消息存储 + 配额已实现并测试；工具路径会话加密可用；面板端到端加密、分片尚未构建 |
| 某些 macOS 主机上的 P2P | `P2P_PUNCH_FAILED`；任务回落到 relay 路径 |
| relay 部署 | relay 升级独立于插件发布；线上版本以 `/healthz` 为准 |
一个 DeepSeek 账号。一句话。你自己的每一台机器跑同一个项目。

1. **同一账号登录自动编队入队**：新机器自动派生身份、加入编队，出现在 `w2m_devices`，无需手动配对。
2. **编队聊天框**：`w2m_chat` 打通编队内沟通，消息存储与配额已就绪；composer 面板与「编队群组」标签共享记录。
3. **编队联合开发 & 多机跨机实时协同**：`w2m_joint_plan` / `w2m_joint_status` + 四种协作模式 + `w2m_council`，把异构机器变成同一个开发编队；审批与派发按 Relay API v1.2 收敛。
4. **一键到顶**：单击滚三轮；1.2 秒内连续点击三次直接回到第一轮（自动展开「加载更早」）。
5. **正文上下文搜索**：主工作区搜索，命中文字绿字黄底高亮，当前项自动滚入视野。
6. **全局文件夹读写黑白名单**：保护系统盘和个人/工作文件夹，把“限制 or 全开”变成可配置的精细边界。

```bash
dsh plugin add @twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin

plugins:
  - '@twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin'

```
